title: Jobs
newJobTitle: Create a new job from a YAML template

empty.title: No jobs registered
empty.body: Use kanade job create <manifest.yaml> on the CLI, or click New job above to open the in-browser YAML editor. Schedules reference jobs by id, so the job must exist before the schedule fires.

noMatch: No jobs match the current filter

live.runningTitle: Running: at least one PC has reported back, more still in flight — click to view this job's running executions in Activity
live.pendingTitle: Pending: fan-out published, no results back yet (auto-expires after 1 h)

actions.runTitle: run — open Exec with this job preselected, then pick targets
actions.editTitle: edit — open this job's YAML manifest
actions.revokeTitle: revoke — block this script from running
actions.unrevokeTitle: unrevoke — allow this script to run again
actions.deleteTitle: delete — remove this job from the catalog

confirm.killDescription_one:
{{count}} run currently in flight (running: {{running}}, pending: {{pending}}). Each agent will terminate its child process and report back with exit_code -1.

Note: this does NOT block the next schedule tick from firing a fresh run — if you want to stop new fires too, click "revoke" alongside.
confirm.killDescription_other:
{{count}} runs currently in flight (running: {{running}}, pending: {{pending}}). Each agent will terminate its child process and report back with exit_code -1.

Note: this does NOT block the next schedule tick from firing a fresh run — if you want to stop new fires too, click "revoke" alongside.
confirm.revokeDescription:
Blocks the script from running on agents. Any pending or in-flight run for this job will be skipped instead of executed, and new fires will refuse to run until you unrevoke it.

Reversible — click "unrevoke" to undo.
confirm.deleteDescription:
Removes the script from the catalog. Any pending or in-flight run for this job will also be blocked (auto-revoke).

Refused if any schedule still references this job — delete the schedule first.
